description: DuckDB's SQL tests on a pgdb:// database in PostgreSQL ($PGVFS_URL): `just sqllogic`.

skip_tests.reason: The init ATTACH looks up pgvfs credentials, which starts the secret manager: its settings are then fixed, and its directory is touched before the test restricts file access.
Measures memory usage (as in force_storage.json), some through pragma_database_size(), which has a row per attached database; fails the same with a local file attached instead.
Concurrent loops that provoke write conflicts: the runner re-runs on_new_connection (USE) before every statement, which fails in the aborted transaction before the test's own COMMIT can end it.
Expects parquet not to be loaded; this config loads it statically.
Requires the latest storage version (as in force_storage.json); fails the same with a local file attached instead.
Expects only the default database (as in force_storage.json); fails the same with a local file attached instead.
Overwrites a local Parquet file in place: loading pgvfs turns on parquet_metadata_cache, so the old footer is used.
